name: Runner Extras - In-Memory Query Joins
brief: Proves multi-dataitem in-memory query joins (InnerJoin + LeftOuterJoin) project the correctly linked parent/child rows.
description: Seeds two in-memory tables (parent QJ Customer, child QJ Order) with known rows and runs queries that join them via DataItemLink. Asserts exact joined-row field values and counts: InnerJoin drops a parent with no child, LeftOuterJoin keeps it with a null/default child column, and a filter yielding no child rows closes the resultset.
